title: The Bakery of Bellbird Bay Anew
author: Elodie Brightwater
blurb: Juniper Nakamura, a marine biologist counting turtles instead of heartbreaks, keeps love in the past tense where it belongs. Then the anonymous pen-pal assignment pairs enemies instead of strangers — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must risk the whole heart instead of lending pieces, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
